llmVisionScreenReview.critique: Content-wise this is one of the better screens: 'Maya Chen attempted to invite Jordan Lee; Jordan remains protected by an active block.', the quoted attempt 'Join my community circle for Saturday event planning.', and 'Safety note from moderator Alex, updated today at 10:30 AM.' all read like real moderation records, and the shield-icon 'Receiver protection' row states the outcome plainly. The failure is actionability: the 'Blocked connection guard' body explicitly promises 'disabled send option, safety reason, appeal/unblock option, and audit timestamp', yet the screen renders no disabled Send control and no Appeal or Unblock affordance anywhere — the promised remedy path is described and then withheld. The 'Conversation actions' card that follows is also pure narration ('The member cannot send the invite while the block is active') rather than a visibly greyed-out button that would make the constraint self-evident.
llmVisionScreenReview.targetProductionSurface: A blocked-target guard should render the Send control in a visibly disabled state with an inline reason, plus a real 'Request unblock' or 'Appeal' button, next to the moderator safety note and audit timestamp.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Across this community's workflows, is it always clear what workflow and what state (start/in-progress/complete) the user is looking at?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Partially. Start and complete states are much weaker. Worse, platform-message-stream cannot be told apart from platform-messages-entry at all — the same "Message thread" sheet and the same "Community message thread / Message sent" complete screen appear under both row IDs, and message-stream's start screen shows "Member connection invite" content.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Across this community's workflows, is it always clear what workflow and what state (start/in-progress/complete) the user is looking at?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Partially. findings.title: Complete screens show mutually exclusive states side by side
findings.description: platform-messages-entry-complete and platform-message-stream-complete display 'Today 9:12 AM, unread until opened.' and 'Reply, mute, archive, or block remain available.' immediately above a 'Message sent' confirmation. platform-connection-invite-complete shows a check-icon 'Accepted — Accepted invites open a thread and connection history.' immediately above 'Connection invite sent'. In each case the screen simultaneously reports two states that cannot both be current.
findings.requiredFix: Update the conversation card to reflect the post-action state (read/sent, or sent-and-pending) so the confirmation and the card above it agree.

findings.title: Start states open mid-scroll on clipped headings and orphaned fragments
findings.description: platform-messages-entry-start opens on the orphan sentence 'preserves read/unread receipt.' directly under the app bar, with an 'Archive thread' chip and 'Reply' pill belonging to an invisible thread. platform-connections-entry-start and platform-connection-invite-start both open on a 'Conversation actions' heading sheared to its descenders. findings.requiredFix: Ensure start states render scrolled to the top of the workflow surface with its title and primary content in view.

findings.title: 'Messages' bottom-nav pill sliced by the right screen edge
findings.description: On the majority of in-app screens the fourth navigation pill renders as 'Messages' with its rounded container cut off by the right edge of the viewport, unlike the fully contained Home, Calendar and Admin pills. On a small number of screens (top-banner-no-fill-complete, sensitive-no-fill-complete, in-stream-ad-complete) the row fits, indicating an inconsistent horizontal layout rather than an intentional scrollable nav.
findings.requiredFix: Constrain the navigation row to the viewport width (or make it explicitly scrollable) so no pill is clipped by the screen edge.
